mapper.select: SELECT sa.id, sa.delegator_id, sa.substitute_id, u.name AS substitute_name, sa.start_date, sa.end_date FROM SUBSTITUTE_APPROVAL sa JOIN USERS u ON sa.substitute_id = u.id WHERE sa.delegator_id = #{delegatorId} ORDER BY sa.start_date DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO SUBSTITUTE_APPROVAL (delegator_id, substitute_id, start_date, end_date) VALUES (#{delegatorId}, #{substituteId}, #{startDate}, #{endDate})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM SUBSTITUTE_APPROVAL WHERE id = #{id} AND delegator_id = #{delegatorId}
mapper.select: SELECT id, delegator_id, substitute_id, start_date, end_date, created_at FROM SUBSTITUTE_APPROVAL WHERE delegator_id = #{delegatorId} AND #{currentDate} BETWEEN start_date AND end_date LIMIT 1
